The FedRAMP High control package supports Agent Assist, Looker, and Vertex AI Vector Search.

The CJIS data boundary supports CJIS compliance in Assured Workloads and has included support such as Access Transparency, Cloud Tasks, Cloud OS Login API, Eventarc, Firebase Security Rules, Generative AI on Vertex AI, Cloud Identity, Cloud Run, Google Workspace Admin Console, Cloud Composer, Dataflow, Cloud DNS, Cloud HSM, Cloud Logging, Cloud NAT, Cloud Router, Cloud SQL, and Network Connectivity Center.

The Impact Level 4 (IL4) data boundary is generally available in Assured Workloads and has included support such as Cloud DNS, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Router, Cloud SQL, Cloud VPN, Pub/Sub, Artifact Registry, Cloud Composer, Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks, Spanner, Certificate Authority Service, Cloud Build, Cloud NAT, GKE Hub, Memorystore for Redis, Secret Manager, and Sensitive Data Protection.

The Impact Level 5 (IL5) data boundary is generally available in Assured Workloads and has included support such as Cloud Logging, Dataflow, Google Kubernetes Engine, Artifact Registry, Cloud Composer, Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks, Spanner, Certificate Authority Service, Cloud Build, Cloud NAT, Cloud VPN, GKE Hub, Memorystore for Redis, Secret Manager, and Sensitive Data Protection.
The ITAR data boundary is generally available in Assured Workloads and has included support such as BigQuery and Service Directory.
The IRS 1075 control package is generally available for IRS Publication 1075 compliance and supports Binary Authorization and Cloud Logging.

The Australia Regions control package supports Cloud Build, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Cloud Workstations, Document AI, Firebase Security Rules, Cloud OS Login API, Storage Transfer Service, and Google Security Operations SOAR.

events.feature_summary: Spanner search indexes can accelerate pattern-matching expressions including LIKE, STARTS_WITH, ENDS_WITH, and REGEXP_CONTAINS.
TOKENIZE_FULLTEXT now includes an option to remove diacritics, which SEARCH and SCORE can use when tokenization is enabled with that option.
TOKENIZE_SUBSTRING now supports emojis in full-text tokenization.

events.feature_name: Property graph creation from SQL views
events.feature_summary: Spanner now supports creating a graph directly from SQL views.
Spanner added the GoogleSQL function ELEMENT_DEFINITION_NAME, which returns the underlying graph element table name for a graph element.
Spanner now supports Data Agents, allowing applications to use conversational-language tools to interact with database data.
Spanner adds support for the PostgreSQL generate_series() function, enabling creation of numeric sequences in SQL queries.

events.feature_name: Spanner Graph ANY CHEAPEST path search prefix
events.feature_summary: Spanner Graph supports the ANY CHEAPEST path search prefix in queries to return a path with the lowest total compute cost.

events.feature_name: Spanner Data Boost concurrent requests milli-operations per second per region quota
events.feature_summary: Spanner Data Boost introduces a concurrent requests quota in milli-operations per second per region, with requests split at 1/1000 granularity for finer sharing of Data Boost resources.

events.feature_name: SPANNER_SYS oldest active queries table new columns
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for new columns in the SPANNER_SYS oldest active queries table, including CLIENT_IP_ADDRESS, API_CLIENT_HEADER, USER_AGENT_HEADER, SERVER_REGION, PRIORITY, and TRANSACTION_TYPE, and exposes them in the Cloud Console query insights page.
Spanner now uses query optimizer version 8 as the default optimizer version.

events.feature_name: IS_FIRST function for GoogleSQL graph queries
events.feature_summary: GoogleSQL added the IS_FIRST function for graph queries, which identifies rows in the first k rows of a window and supports edge-limiting and node-sampling optimizations.

events.feature_name: Spanner Studio query result export options
events.feature_summary: Spanner Studio added support for exporting query results to CSV or JSON files, Google Sheets, and copying results to the clipboard.

events.feature_name: Spanner schema design best practice recommendations
events.feature_summary: Spanner now provides automated schema design best-practice recommendations in Spanner Studio to help improve database schema quality.
Spanner Graph now supports named schemas, enabling schema-based organization of graph objects.
Schema object drop protection in Cloud Spanner prevents accidental deletion of schema objects such as tables, indexes, and columns.

events.feature_name: GoogleSQL ML.PREDICT function for ANN vector search
events.feature_summary: The GoogleSQL ML.PREDICT function can convert natural language query text into embeddings and perform approximate nearest-neighbors vector search.
Spanner adds repeatable read isolation support to reduce latency and transaction abort rates in read-heavy workloads with fewer writes.
The Spanner command-line interface is now generally available and can open interactive sessions or run SQL from shell commands and input files.

events.feature_name: BigQuery non-incremental materialized views on Cloud Spanner
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner now supports creating BigQuery non-incremental materialized views over Spanner data to improve query performance through periodic result caching.
The Spanner Cassandra interface is now generally available, enabling access to Spanner using familiar Cassandra tools and syntax.
Spanner now includes a dedicated Gemini CLI extension that allows users to execute SQL statements and query a Spanner instance using natural language controls.

Read lease regions for Spanner allow strong reads to be served locally from designated non-leader regions in multi-region or dual-region instances, reducing latency by avoiding leader-region round trips.

events.feature_name: Spanner federated queries with BigQuery external datasets
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports running GoogleSQL federated queries against PostgreSQL dialect databases through BigQuery external datasets, including cross-region queries.
Spanner Graph now generally supports schemaless schemas.
Spanner now supports importing data into a database from CSV files, MySQL dump files, or PostgreSQL dump files.
Spanner now supports populating new databases in existing instances with sample datasets to explore core capabilities such as relational, full-text, vector search, and Spanner Graph features.
Spanner now supports terminating multiple active long-running queries in an instance to help reduce resource load and instance latency.
Spanner now supports cross-region federated queries so Spanner tables can be queried from BigQuery regions different from the source region.

events.feature_name: Predefined MySQL function library for Spanner
events.feature_summary: Spanner offers a predefined library of over 80 MySQL-compatible user-defined functions that can be installed into a database to reduce migration changes from MySQL.

The Spanner columnar engine provides a preview storage and query acceleration technique for analytical workloads, improving scan performance on live operational data by up to 200x without impacting transactional workloads.

Spanner free trial instances now automatically create and preload a sample ecommerce database when launched from the Google Cloud Console, enabling users to run preloaded queries and explore Spanner capabilities.

events.feature_name: BigQuery continuous query export to Spanner
events.feature_summary: Adds support for using continuous queries to export data from BigQuery into Cloud Spanner in real time.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner Java and Go client-side AFE/GFE metrics
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner added new client-side AFE and GFE metrics for Java and Go applications, including connectivity error count and latency metrics for both fronts.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner query execution plan JSON export
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner now allows users to download and save query execution plans as JSON files for visualization in Spanner Studio.
Provides an interactive Spanner shell integrated into the Google Cloud CLI for running interactive sessions and automating SQL execution from the shell or input files.
Adds a simplified workflow to create Spanner free trial instances for 90-day exploration, including support for relational databases in GoogleSQL/PostgreSQL and NoSQL models.
Column operations statistics is a Cloud Spanner feature that provides insights into and monitoring of column usage in databases.

events.feature_name: BigQuery support for Spanner external datasets
events.feature_summary: BigQuery now supports querying Spanner external datasets with authorized views, authorized routines, and Cloud Resource Connections.

events.feature_name: Cross-regional federated queries from BigQuery to Spanner
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports querying Spanner tables from BigQuery in a different region than the BigQuery region through cross-region federation.

events.feature_name: Efficient incremental backup copy chains in Spanner
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports copying incremental backups by transferring only the incremental backup and any missing older backups in the chain, reusing existing chain segments at the destination to reduce redundant storage and network costs.
Spanner now supports creating pre-filtered vector indexes that restrict ANN searches to rows matching a specified filter condition, improving search performance and recall.
Spanner now supports the INTERVAL data type in GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL, enabling representation of durations and amounts of time in both SQL dialects.
Spanner now supports the SPLIT_SUBSTR() GoogleSQL function for extracting a substring from a string based on delimiter-separated segment count and index.
Spanner now supports ADDDATE() as an alias for the DATE_ADD() function in GoogleSQL.
Spanner now supports SUBDATE() as an alias for the DATE_SUB() function in GoogleSQL.
Spanner now supports LCASE() as an alias for the LOWER() function in GoogleSQL.
Spanner now supports UCASE() as an alias for the UPPER() function in GoogleSQL.
Spanner Graph now supports modeling schemaless data using dynamic labels and properties.

events.feature_name: enhance_query option for SEARCH, SCORE, and SNIPPET functions
events.feature_summary: The SEARCH, SCORE, and SNIPPET functions now support an enhance_query option that enables automatic synonym matching and single-word spell correction by default.
Spanner now generally supports manually adding split points to pre-split a database before anticipated traffic spikes to improve scaling performance.

events.feature_name: Spanner INTERLEAVE IN clause without PARENT option
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports using INTERLEAVE IN without the PARENT option to colocate child rows with parent rows, allowing child-row insertion before parent insertion and preserving child rows when deleting the parent.
Spanner now offers generally available end-to-end tracing, including client-side tracing support in Node.js and Python client libraries in addition to existing Java and Go tracing support.

events.feature_name: Gemini assistance for Spanner optimization and troubleshooting
events.feature_summary: Spanner now supports Gemini-powered assistance to help optimize and troubleshoot Spanner resources using system insights.

events.feature_name: Spanner Cassandra compatibility and migration tools
events.feature_summary: Spanner now provides Cassandra API compatibility with migration tools to enable lift-and-shift migration of Cassandra applications.
Spanner adds a PARAMETER_DEFAULT column to INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS that returns default values for change stream read function parameters.
Spanner Graph now supports visualizing query result graphs and schema graphs to help identify patterns, dependencies, and anomalies.
Spanner now supports GoogleSQL JSON mutator functions, including JSON_ARRAY_APPEND, JSON_ARRAY_INSERT, JSON_REMOVE, JSON_SET, and JSON_STRIP_NULLS.
Spanner now supports PostgreSQL JSONB mutator functions, including jsonb_insert, jsonb_set, jsonb_set_lax, and jsonb_strip_nulls.
Spanner adds PostgreSQL JSONB operators, including concat (jsonb || jsonb) and delete (jsonb - text).
Spanner makes JSON search indexes generally available to accelerate JSON document queries over JSON and JSONB data across both GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL dialects.
The GoogleSQL JSON_KEYS function is generally available in Spanner and returns the unique keys from a JSON expression.
The PostgreSQL json_object_keys function is generally available in Spanner and returns the unique keys from a JSON expression.
Spanner ANN indexes are now supported for use with LangChain.
Spanner made vector indexes in the GoogleSQL dialect generally available, enabling faster similarity search and nearest-neighbor queries on large vector tables.

events.feature_name: Approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) distance functions in GoogleSQL
events.feature_summary: Spanner GA support for ANN distance functions in GoogleSQL was introduced for similarity and nearest-neighbor workloads.
Spanner Studio now supports saving and managing SQL scripts as part of a preview capability.

events.feature_name: Spanner database default time zone setting
events.feature_summary: This feature enables setting a default time zone for a Spanner database.

events.feature_name: Reverse ETL from BigQuery to Spanner using EXPORT DATA statements
events.feature_summary: This feature allows using EXPORT DATA statements to load data from BigQuery into Spanner.
Adds support for creating a BigQuery external dataset that links directly to an existing Cloud Spanner database.
Introduces generally available tiered storage for Spanner, allowing data to be stored on SSD for performance and HDD for lower-cost infrequent access.
Spanner Graph now supports a LangChain graph-store integration for retrieving and storing nodes and edges in a graph database.
Spanner Graph now supports a LangChain Graph QA chain integration that uses a graph to answer questions.
Spanner has added a new Europe multi-region instance configuration, eur7, covering Milan, Frankfurt, and Turin.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner regional instance configuration in europe-north2
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner now supports creating regional instance configurations in the Stockholm (europe-north2) region.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner full-text search for PostgreSQL dialect
events.feature_summary: Full-text search is generally available for Cloud Spanner PostgreSQL-dialect databases.
Spanner Java and Go clients now support multiplexed sessions, allowing concurrent requests over a single session and eliminating the need to set fixed minimum or maximum session counts.

Spanner managed autoscaler is now generally available and supports independent autoscaling configuration for read-only replicas separate from read-write replicas using capacity and CPU utilization targets.
Spanner supports custom organization policies as a generally available feature.
Cloud Spanner informational foreign keys are now available to declare intended logical relationships without enforcing referential integrity, primarily for query optimization.
Cloud Spanner enforced foreign keys are available to enforce referential integrity constraints between tables.
The Spanner index advisor analyzes queries and recommends new or adjusted indexes to improve query performance in GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL-dialect databases.
Spanner adds support for the SERIAL DDL syntax in PostgreSQL-dialect databases to simplify identity-style primary key generation.
Spanner adds support for the AUTO_INCREMENT DDL syntax in GoogleSQL to streamline creating IDENTITY-like primary key columns.
Spanner now supports downgrading a Spanner instance to a lower edition tier.
Spanner now supports SELECT ... FOR UPDATE syntax in GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL dialects to enable exclusive locks during scans and reduce concurrent-write aborts.
Provides query statistics for previously executed partitioned DML statements in Spanner.
Adds monitoring and troubleshooting support for long-running active queries in a Spanner instance.
Spanner now supports ANSI-compliant IDENTITY columns to generate unique integer values for both key and non-key columns.

events.feature_name: Spanner Database Reader with Data Boost IAM role
events.feature_summary: A predefined IAM role named Spanner Database Reader with Data Boost is introduced to allow querying Spanner databases using Data Boost.

Spanner now supports default backup schedules that are automatically enabled for new instances and create full backups every 24 hours with 7-day retention for each new database, with options to enable, disable, edit, or delete schedules.
Spanner adds support for the ALL_DIFFERENT graph predicate in GoogleSQL-dialect databases to test whether graph elements in a list are mutually distinct.

events.feature_name: Spanner regional instance configuration in northamerica-south1
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for creating regional instance configurations in the Querétaro (northamerica-south1) region.

events.feature_name: Spanner client-side metrics for Java and Go
events.feature_summary: Spanner added client-side metrics support for Java and Go applications, available in Java client library v6.81.0+ and Go client library v1.71.0+.
Cloud Spanner introduced Query Optimizer version 8, while version 7 remains the default optimizer version.
Cloud Spanner added support for customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) to protect databases in custom, dual-region, and multi-region instance configurations.
Adds the Spanner Graph DESTINATION_NODE_ID() function, which returns the unique identifier of a graph edge's destination node.
Adds the Spanner Graph ELEMENT_ID() function, which returns the unique identifier of a graph element.
Adds the Spanner Graph SOURCE_NODE_ID() function, which returns the unique identifier of a graph edge's source node.
Makes Spanner Directed Reads generally available, enabling read-only transactions and single reads to be directed to a specific replica type or region in a multi-region instance.
Adds usage statistics for Spanner database splits, surfaced with the System Insights dashboard, to help identify hotspot rows in the database.
Makes Query Optimizer version 7 generally available as the default optimizer version in Spanner.
Spanner now supports scheduled incremental backups, allowing users to define backup frequency and retention while storing only changes since the previous backup.
Spanner now offers an open-source Cassandra-to-Spanner proxy adapter to migrate Cassandra workloads to Spanner without modifying application logic.
Spanner is supported in Database Center, allowing Spanner resources to be tracked in fleet inventory and the resource table.

events.feature_name: Spanner health issue monitoring in Database Center
events.feature_summary: Database Center can monitor Spanner health issues such as short backup retention, stale last backup, and non-replicating resources across regions.
Spanner now supports a subset of PostgreSQL pg_system_catalog tables and views.
Spanner supports creating and managing backup schedules to define backup timing, frequency, retention, and encryption type.
Spanner full-text search became generally available.
Spanner adds support for the SAFE_TO_JSON function in GoogleSQL, enabling conversion of SQL objects to JSON while returning JSON null for invalid JSON types instead of raising errors.

events.feature_name: BigQuery external dataset integration with Spanner
events.feature_summary: Spanner adds the ability to create BigQuery external datasets linked to existing Spanner databases, and the feature is available in Preview.

events.feature_name: Spanner FLOAT32 and float4/real data types
events.feature_summary: Spanner made the FLOAT32 (GoogleSQL) and float4/real (PostgreSQL) data types generally available.
Spanner now supports generally available K-nearest neighbors vector similarity search using COSINE_DISTANCE(), EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE(), and DOT_PRODUCT() functions.
Spanner added end-to-end tracing support in preview, including client-side tracing in the Java and Go client libraries.
Spanner added support for the spanner.farm_fingerprint() hash function in PostgreSQL-dialect databases.
Cloud Spanner now supports a tier-based editions model with Standard, Enterprise, and Enterprise Plus options to match features and pricing to workload needs.

events.feature_name: Cloud KMS Autokey support for Cloud Spanner
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner can use Cloud KMS Autokey-generated customer-managed keys for CMEK encryption.
Added the North America Spanner multi-region instance configuration named nam16 (Iowa, Northern Virginia, Columbus).
Introduced Spanner Graph in preview, adding purpose-built graph database capabilities to Spanner with a GQL-compatible query interface and interoperability between relational and graph models.
Cloud Spanner full-text search (Preview) adds table search by words, phrases, or integers with spelling correction, automatic language detection, and ranked result ordering.
Cloud Spanner now supports the JSON_ARRAY() function in GoogleSQL for constructing JSON array values.
Cloud Spanner now supports the JSON_OBJECT() function in GoogleSQL for constructing JSON object values.
Spanner now supports the GoogleSQL BOOL_ARRAY function to convert a JSON boolean array into a SQL ARRAY.
Spanner now supports the GoogleSQL FLOAT32 function to convert a JSON number into a SQL FLOAT32 value.
Spanner now supports the GoogleSQL FLOAT32_ARRAY function to convert a JSON array of numbers into a SQL ARRAY.
Spanner now supports the GoogleSQL FLOAT64_ARRAY function to convert a JSON array of numbers into a SQL ARRAY.
Spanner now supports the GoogleSQL INT64_ARRAY function to convert a JSON array of numbers into a SQL INT64_ARRAY.
Spanner now supports the GoogleSQL STRING_ARRAY function to convert a JSON array of strings into a SQL ARRAY.
Spanner now supports the PostgreSQL JSONB function jsonb_array_elements().
Spanner now supports the PostgreSQL JSONB function spanner.bool_array().
Spanner now supports the PostgreSQL JSONB function spanner.float32_array().
Spanner now supports the PostgreSQL JSONB function spanner.float64_array().
Spanner now supports the PostgreSQL JSONB function spanner.int64_array().
Spanner now supports the PostgreSQL JSONB function spanner.string_array().
GoogleSQL INSERT OR UPDATE and INSERT OR IGNORE statements now support the THEN RETURN clause, including support for the WITH ACTION option.

events.feature_name: PostgreSQL INSERT ON CONFLICT RETURNING support
events.feature_summary: PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DML statements in Spanner now support the RETURNING clause.
Spanner now supports Geo-partitioning in Preview to segment and store table rows across different geographic configurations.
Cloud Spanner added support for the GoogleSQL PDML_MAX_PARALLELISM statement-level hint in query statements.
Cloud Spanner added dual-region instance configurations for Australia, Germany, India, and Japan to support regional replication and data residency requirements.

events.feature_name: Spanner ANN distance functions in GoogleSQL
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports ANN vector distance functions APPROX_COSINE_DISTANCE(), APPROX_EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE(), and APPROX_DOT_PRODUCT() in GoogleSQL.

events.feature_name: Spanner vector index creation via DDL
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports creating vector indexes with DDL statements to accelerate similarity and nearest-neighbor queries on large vector datasets.

events.feature_name: BigQuery reverse ETL to Spanner via EXPORT DATA
events.feature_summary: Spanner adds support for using EXPORT DATA statements to perform reverse ETL from BigQuery into Spanner.
Multiplexed sessions provide a new session management model that simplifies client-side pool management.
Spanner now allows privileged users to cancel long-running queries in GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL environments.
Named schemas is now generally available in Spanner, allowing database objects to be grouped in namespaces to avoid naming conflicts and manage fine-grained access control collectively.
Generated columns in Spanner now work without the STORED attribute, so values are evaluated at query or index time without additional storage or write overhead.
Spanner introduced query optimizer version 7 as generally available.

events.feature_name: Protocol Buffer Data Type Support in GoogleSQL
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the protocol buffer data type in GoogleSQL.

events.feature_name: Spanner SPANNER_SYS query statistics column AVG_MEMORY_PEAK_USAGE_BYTES
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the AVG_MEMORY_PEAK_USAGE_BYTES column in the SPANNER_SYS query statistics table.

events.feature_name: Spanner SPANNER_SYS query statistics column AVG_MEMORY_USAGE_PERCENTAGE
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the AVG_MEMORY_USAGE_PERCENTAGE column in the SPANNER_SYS query statistics table.

events.feature_name: Spanner SPANNER_SYS query statistics column AVG_QUERY_PLAN_CREATION_TIME_SECS
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the AVG_QUERY_PLAN_CREATION_TIME_SECS column in the SPANNER_SYS query statistics table.

events.feature_name: Spanner SPANNER_SYS query statistics column AVG_FILESYSTEM_DELAY_SECS
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the AVG_FILESYSTEM_DELAY_SECS column in the SPANNER_SYS query statistics table.

events.feature_name: Spanner SPANNER_SYS query statistics column AVG_REMOTE_SERVER_CALLS
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the AVG_REMOTE_SERVER_CALLS column in the SPANNER_SYS query statistics table.

events.feature_name: Spanner SPANNER_SYS query statistics column AVG_ROWS_SPOOLED
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the AVG_ROWS_SPOOLED column in the SPANNER_SYS query statistics table.
Spanner has made vector length annotation generally available for vector data definitions.

events.feature_name: Spanner change_stream read latency metric in Cloud Monitoring
events.feature_summary: Cloud Monitoring now supports the `read_request_latencies_by_change_stream` metric so Spanner users can view and filter all read latencies by change-stream and non-change-stream reads.
Spanner now supports zero-downtime self-service updates to base instance configurations, including adding or removing read-only replicas and moving an instance to a different instance configuration.
Cloud Spanner now supports PostgreSQL array features including UNNEST, array slicing, ANY/SOME/ALL comparisons, and array overlap/containment functions and operators.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner vector embedding generation from text via partitioned DML
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner can generate and backfill vector embeddings for STRING or JSON textual data in bulk using GoogleSQL partitioned DML with the Vertex AI textembedding-gecko model.
Adds support for the SAFE.ML.PREDICT() function in GoogleSQL so prediction statements can return NULL instead of an error.
Adds the ML_PREDICT_ROW() SQL function to Spanner for PostgreSQL to generate predictions directly from SQL.
Spanner emulator now supports generating machine-learning predictions when using GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL.
Spanner now supports integration with LangChain for vector store, document loader, and chat message history objects.
Spanner added a VECTOR LENGTH parameter to the ARRAY type to allow fixed-size arrays for vector search.
Spanner adds support for additional PostgreSQL JSONB functions, including spanner.jsonb_query_array(), jsonb_build_array(), and jsonb_build_object().
Spanner’s PostgreSQL-compatible CONCAT() function now supports more than four arguments.
Spanner Studio lets users access and manipulate Spanner SQL databases by running SQL queries from the Google Cloud Console.
Spanner supports using Gemini models with GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL machine learning prediction functions.
Spanner added support for the dot_product() function to enable vector similarity calculations using vector distance metrics.

events.feature_name: Gemini model integration with Spanner machine learning prediction functions
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for using Gemini models with GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL machine learning prediction functions.

events.feature_name: Spanner Change Streams NEW_ROW_AND_OLD_VALUES capture type
events.feature_summary: Spanner Change Streams now supports the NEW_ROW_AND_OLD_VALUES capture type, which records new values for all columns and old values for modified columns.

events.feature_name: Spanner Change Streams table modification type filters
events.feature_summary: Spanner Change Streams now supports filtering by table modification type to exclude INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE changes.

events.feature_name: Spanner Change Streams TTL-based deletes filter
events.feature_summary: Spanner Change Streams now support a TTL-based deletes filter via the exclude_ttl_deletes option.
Spanner write requests now support a configurable maximum delay between 0 and 500 milliseconds for throughput-optimized writes.
Leader-aware routing directs read-write transactions in Spanner multi-region instances to the leader region to reduce latency and improve performance.
Spanner now provides statistics for active partitioned DML queries, including query progress, in statistics tables.
Allows Spanner tables to be renamed in place and to safely swap table names using synonyms.
Introduces an auto-generated Spanner client library interface for admin operations, with newer admin features available only through this interface.
Spanner supports a regional endpoint in the me-central2 region so workloads can run with data locality restrictions for compliance needs.
The Spanner GoogleSQL LAX_BOOL JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON value to a SQL BOOL.
The Spanner GoogleSQL LAX_FLOAT64 JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON value to a SQL FLOAT64.
The Spanner GoogleSQL LAX_INT64 JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON value to a SQL INT64.
The Spanner GoogleSQL LAX_STRING JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON value to a SQL STRING.
The Spanner GoogleSQL BOOL JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON boolean to a SQL BOOL.
The Spanner GoogleSQL FLOAT64 JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON number to a SQL FLOAT64.
The Spanner GoogleSQL INT64 JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON number to a SQL INT64.
The Spanner GoogleSQL STRING JSON function is now generally available and converts a JSON string to a SQL STRING.
The Spanner GoogleSQL JSON_TYPE function is now generally available and returns the JSON type of the outermost JSON value as a SQL STRING.
Spanner now supports OpenTelemetry for observability and instrumentation needs.
Spanner-related OpenCensus libraries have been archived, and users are advised to migrate to OpenTelemetry.
Spanner now supports creating regional instances in Johannesburg, South Africa (africa-south1).
Spanner directed reads let read-only transactions and single reads be routed to a specific replica type or region in a multi-region instance.

events.feature_name: Spanner GoogleSQL INSERT OR IGNORE and INSERT OR UPDATE clauses
events.feature_summary: Spanner now supports the GoogleSQL INSERT OR IGNORE and INSERT OR UPDATE clauses.
Spanner now supports PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET clauses.
Adds support for the COSINE_DISTANCE() vector distance SQL function in Cloud Spanner (Preview) for similarity vector search.
Adds support for the EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE() vector distance SQL function in Cloud Spanner (Preview) for similarity vector search.

events.feature_name: Partition queries without distributed union plans
events.feature_summary: Adds support for partition queries in Cloud Spanner when query plans do not include distributed unions.
Spanner adds generally available support for Data Catalog resource management.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL UNNEST function in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL array_length function in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL array(subquery) construct in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL date_trunc function in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL extract function in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL spanner.date_bin function in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL spanner.timestamptz_add function in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports the PostgreSQL spanner.timestamptz_subtract function in the PostgreSQL dialect.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner emulator PostgreSQL dialect support
events.feature_summary: Spanner emulator support for the PostgreSQL dialect is generally available.

events.feature_name: GoogleSQL Hibernate dialect support for Hibernate ORM 6.3
events.feature_summary: Spanner now supports Hibernate ORM 6.3 via the GoogleSQL Hibernate dialect.
Spanner now supports automatic cleanup of long-running transactions in Java and Go clients to prevent session leaks and emit warning logs for problematic transactions.

events.feature_name: Spanner integration with Vertex AI Vector Search
events.feature_summary: Spanner now supports an integration workflow with Vertex AI Vector Search to enable vector similarity search on data stored in Spanner.
Spanner managed autoscaler automatically increases or decreases instance compute capacity based on workload, storage needs, and user-defined goals.
Batch-oriented scans enable Spanner to execute certain queries using a batch processing mode to improve scan throughput and performance.
Spanner now supports the GORM ORM for Go with GoogleSQL-dialect databases.
Table and index operations statistics is now generally available for monitoring table and index usage in Spanner databases.
Spanner applies optimizations to groups of statements in ExecuteBatchDml API batches to improve update performance and latency.

events.feature_name: FULL JOIN with USING in Spanner PostgreSQL dialect
events.feature_summary: Spanner adds support for FULL JOIN with the USING clause in PostgreSQL-dialect databases.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner PostgreSQL SELECT DISTINCT support
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner's PostgreSQL dialect added support for the SELECT DISTINCT SQL statement.
Query Optimizer version 6 became generally available in Cloud Spanner and was set as the default optimizer version.

events.feature_name: Spanner regional and multi-region throughput improvements
events.feature_summary: Spanner instances in select regional and multi-region configurations now support higher throughput without additional cost or configuration changes.
Spanner batch write (Preview) allows committing multiple mutations non-atomically in a single low-latency request.

events.feature_name: Spanner Vertex AI text embeddings integration
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for generating text embeddings using Vertex AI Generative AI through its Vertex AI integration.

events.feature_name: Spanner Vertex AI text-bison model support
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the Vertex AI text-bison model via its Vertex AI integration.
Spanner now offers sampled query plans in GA, enabling users to view historical query plans and compare query performance over time.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner regional instances in me-central2
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner supports creating regional instances in the me-central2 (Dammam, Saudi Arabia) region.
Cloud Spanner adds support for creating definer's rights views, allowing users to query view contents without direct access to underlying schema objects.
Cloud Spanner made query optimizer version 6 generally available, while version 5 remains the default optimizer in production.
Cloud Spanner added a new multi-region instance configuration in the asia2 region pair (Mumbai, Delhi, Singapore).
Spanner Studio includes Gemini in Preview to help users write SQL statements more quickly with AI-powered collaboration.

events.feature_name: Spanner PostgreSQL functions and operators support
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for 13 PostgreSQL-compatible functions and operators, expanding SQL compatibility for PostgreSQL syntax.

events.feature_name: Spanner SEQUENCE DDL for primary key default values
events.feature_summary: Adds support for integer SEQUENCE DDL objects used in PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT expressions to generate unique, uniformly distributed integer keys.
Adds the BIT_REVERSE function to map integer keys using bit-reversal logic, helping reduce hotspotting in key-based distributions.

events.feature_name: Spanner UUID primary key default generation
events.feature_summary: Adds support for generating UUID v4 values as a PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT expression using GENERATE_UUID in GoogleSQL or generate_uuid() in PostgreSQL dialects.
Spanner now supports creating regional instances in the Berlin region, europe-west10.

events.feature_name: Spanner Studio query editor SQL/DML/DDL support
events.feature_summary: Spanner Studio in the Google Cloud console now provides full support for SQL, DML, and DDL operations in the query editor.
Spanner Studio includes an Explorer pane in Preview that enables interactive browsing, querying, and modifying databases.
Spanner Data Boost is now available in all Google Cloud regions.
Spanner now supports checking progress for long-running operations, including backups, restores, and schema updates, and this capability is generally available.
Database deletion protection in Cloud Spanner prevents accidental database deletions by requiring protection to be disabled before a database can be removed.
Spanner supports cascading delete actions for foreign keys, automatically deleting related rows when a referenced row is removed.
Spanner Data Boost enables running analytics queries and exporting data with near-zero impact on existing provisioned Spanner workloads.
Spanner Vertex AI integration makes it possible to use Vertex AI with GoogleSQL to add machine learning capabilities to Spanner applications.

events.feature_name: IF EXISTS and IF NOT EXISTS clause support in Spanner DDL
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for IF NOT EXISTS in CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, and ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN, and IF EXISTS in DROP TABLE and DROP INDEX for both GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL dialects.

events.feature_name: Fine-grained access control for PostgreSQL-dialect databases
events.feature_summary: Fine-grained access control is available for databases using the PostgreSQL dialect in Spanner.
Spanner now supports using generated columns as part of a table's primary key.
Spanner offers database deletion protection in preview, allowing databases to be protected from accidental deletion.

events.feature_name: Automatic query parallelism in Cloud Spanner
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner can automatically increase the degree of parallelism used to execute a query when the instance size permits it.

events.feature_name: Processing duration audit logging for Spanner read and write requests
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner now logs the processing duration of read and write requests in Cloud Audit Logs.
Spanner now offers sampled query plans in Preview, enabling users to view historical query plan samples and compare query performance over time.
Spanner PostgreSQL dialect queries now support set operations such as UNION and INTERSECT, including use with ORDER BY, LIMIT, OFFSET, and in subqueries.

events.feature_name: Parameterized LIMIT and OFFSET in Spanner PostgreSQL dialect
events.feature_summary: Spanner PostgreSQL dialect now supports parameterized LIMIT and OFFSET operations in queries.
Spanner PostgreSQL dialect query statements now support optimizer hints such as optimizer_version and optimizer_statistics_package to configure query optimization.
Added new North America multi-region Spanner instance configurations nam14 (Northern Virginia/Montreal/South Carolina) and nam15 (Dallas/Northern Virginia/Iowa).
Increased the maximum number of indexes allowed per table in Spanner from 32 to 128.
Spanner integration with Data Catalog is available in Preview in the europe-central2 region.
Spanner is integrated with Data Catalog (Dataplex Universal Catalog) to catalog metadata for Spanner instances, databases, tables, columns, and views.

events.feature_name: Regional Spanner instances in Doha, Qatar (me-central1)
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports creating regional instances in the Doha, Qatar (me-central1) region.

events.feature_name: Regional Spanner instances in Turin, Italy (europe-west12)
events.feature_summary: Spanner supports creating regional instances in the Turin, Italy (europe-west12) region.
Spanner GoogleSQL now supports the ARRAY_FILTER function.
Spanner GoogleSQL now supports the ARRAY_TRANSFORM function.
Spanner GoogleSQL now supports lambda expressions.
Spanner now supports using Google Cloud tags to organize instances and scope IAM policies by instance tags.
GoogleSQL added the ARRAY_INCLUDES_ALL function to support checking whether all specified elements are present in an array.
GoogleSQL added the ARRAY_INCLUDES_ANY function to support checking whether any specified element is present in an array.
GoogleSQL added the ARRAY_MIN function to return the minimum value from an array.
GoogleSQL added the ARRAY_MAX function to return the maximum value from an array.
GoogleSQL added support for the THEN RETURN clause in query statements.
The PostgreSQL dialect in Spanner added support for the RETURNING clause.
Spanner fine-grained access control is now generally available, combining IAM with traditional SQL role-based access control.

events.feature_name: JSONB array data type support in PostgreSQL dialect
events.feature_summary: Spanner added support for the JSONB array data type in its PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner supports Change Streams for databases using the PostgreSQL dialect.
Spanner provides a system insights dashboard that displays metrics and scorecards for instances and databases.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner console copy backup operation monitoring
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner now shows the status and progress of copy backup long-running operations in the Google Cloud console for seven days after initiation.

events.feature_name: Cloud Spanner console PostgreSQL DDL autocomplete and validation
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner provides autocomplete and syntax validation for DDL statements in the Google Cloud console when editing PostgreSQL-dialect databases.
Spanner regional endpoints allow clients to connect through endpoints limited to a specific region to help enforce regional data residency and control requirements.
Spanner provides generally available table size statistics to give insights into the size of individual database tables.
The Spanner Kafka connector publishes Cloud Spanner change stream records to Apache Kafka for application integration and event triggering.
Spanner ALTER INDEX statement now supports adding columns to an index and dropping non-key columns.

events.feature_name: Custom instance configurations with read-only replicas
events.feature_summary: Spanner allows you to create custom instance configurations and add optional read-only replicas to improve read scalability and support low-latency stale reads.

events.feature_name: Spanner change streams to Pub/Sub Dataflow template
events.feature_summary: Spanner adds a Dataflow template that streams change stream records from Spanner and writes them to Pub/Sub topics.

events.feature_name: Spanner Change Streams NEW_VALUES and NEW_ROW data capture modes
events.feature_summary: Spanner Change Streams added NEW_VALUES and NEW_ROW change-record capture modes, with NEW_VALUES capturing only new non-key values and NEW_ROW capturing the full new row, while keys remain always included and old values are not captured.
Cloud Spanner supports moving an instance to any other instance configuration, including between regional and multi-region configurations.

events.feature_name: Spanner DML RETURNING and THEN RETURN support
events.feature_summary: Added support in Spanner DML for returning updated rows in the same statement using PostgreSQL RETURNING and Google Standard SQL THEN RETURN.

events.feature_name: Concurrent database restore operations per instance
events.feature_summary: Increased the maximum number of concurrent Spanner database restore operations per instance from five to ten.
Cloud Spanner adds Time to Live (TTL) support for PostgreSQL-dialect databases, enabling automatic deletion of data based on user-defined retention policies.
Cloud Spanner adds support for the JSONB data type in the PostgreSQL dialect.
Cloud Spanner added support for copying database backups between instances in different regions and projects to improve data protection and compliance.

events.feature_name: NHibernate ORM support for Cloud Spanner
events.feature_summary: Cloud Spanner added generally available support for the NHibernate ORM, enabling Spanner to be used as the backend database for NHibernate applications.
Spanner now allows up to five simultaneous database restore operations per instance instead of one.
The Lock Insights dashboard identifies latency spikes in Spanner databases that are caused by lock contention.
The Transaction Insights dashboard identifies transactions in Spanner databases that cause lock contention and potential high latency.
Spanner Vertex AI integration enables Spanner applications to use machine learning capabilities through Google Standard SQL.
The SPANNER_SYS Transaction statistics table was enhanced with new columns including TOTAL_LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION, OPERATIONS_BY_TABLE, and ATTEMPT_COUNT.
The SPANNER_SYS Query statistics table was enhanced with new columns including LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION and RUN_IN_RW_TRANSACTION_EXECUTION_COUNT.
The SPANNER_SYS Read statistics table was enhanced with a new RUN_IN_RW_TRANSACTION_EXECUTION_COUNT column.
Google Standard SQL for Spanner now supports the ARRAY_SLICE function, which returns a contiguous subset of elements from an input array.
The Spanner Golang database/sql driver is now generally available, enabling use of Go's standard database/sql package with Spanner.
Fine-grained access control for Cloud Spanner lets you secure databases at the table and column level using RDBMS-style roles with GRANT and REVOKE SQL statements.
Cloud Spanner regional instances can be created in the Tel Aviv region (me-west1).
Query optimizer version 5 is generally available in Spanner and is the default optimizer version.
Spanner free trial instances are generally available, allowing new users to run 90-day trials with up to 10 GB of data and later upgrade.
Added support for the DISABLE_INLINE hint in Google Standard SQL function calls so a function can be computed once and reused across multiple references in a query.
Made Query Optimizer version 5 generally available for Spanner query planning, while noting version 4 remains the production default.
Adds GA support for viewing aggregated Spanner statistics in Cloud Monitoring, including transactions, reads, queries, and lock contentions.
Introduces the ANALYZE DDL command so administrators can manually refresh the optimizer's query statistics package for faster adaptation to frequent changes in data, queries, or indexes.
Query Insights in Cloud Spanner provides visual detection of query performance issues and deeper analysis to identify their root causes.
The Spanner PostgreSQL interface adds PostgreSQL compatibility to Spanner with support for a core PostgreSQL SQL dialect, psql, native language clients, and Google tooling integration.
Spanner added a query optimization that uses commit timestamps to reduce I/O when retrieving data written after a specified time.
Spanner added support for creating regional instances in the Dallas (us-south1) region.
Spanner supports granular instance sizing by allowing production instances to be created with fewer than 1,000 processing units.
Spanner change streams capture and stream inserts, updates, and deletes in near real time for use in analytics, archiving, and downstream workflows.

CSV export now supports the spannerSnapshotTime option to export data as it existed at a specific past point in time.

Spanner added support for changing instance configuration as a preview capability.

events.feature_name: Storage Transfer Service HDFS source support

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Feature Store Feature Value Monitoring

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Model Monitoring for batch prediction jobs

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Pipelines ParallelFor concurrency controls

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Explainable AI example-based explanations

Enables profiling and performance debugging for Vertex AI custom training jobs using TensorFlow Profiler.
Adds Preview support for custom prediction containers in Vertex AI with pre- and post-processing logic.

Vertex AI introduced Pipeline Templates in Preview to create, publish, and manage reusable machine-learning pipeline templates, including running and filtering pipeline executions.

Tabular Workflows on Vertex AI was introduced as a Preview feature.
The End-to-End AutoML workflow in Vertex AI was introduced in Public Preview.
Vertex AI Experiments is generally available and helps users track, compare, and analyze multiple experiment runs and model metrics.

events.feature_name: Explainable AI for Vertex AI Forecasting

events.feature_name: Holiday effect modeling in Vertex AI Forecasting
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Forecasting supports modeling holiday effects during model training.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI resource-level IAM policies for Feature Store and EntityType resources
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now supports applying IAM policies at the individual Feature Store and EntityType resource level.

events.feature_name: Configurable failure policies for Vertex AI pipeline runs

Vertex AI private endpoints provide general availability for secure, low-latency access to the online prediction service through VPC Network Peering.

events.feature_name: Custom model training on TPU VMs
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now allows users to train custom models using Cloud TPU Architecture (TPU VMs).

events.feature_name: Vertex AI pre-built PyTorch 1.11 training container

events.feature_name: NFS share mounting for custom training jobs
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI added support for mounting Network File System (NFS) shares during custom training jobs to access remote files.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Feature Store online store autoscaling

events.feature_name: Vertex AI pre-built container for TensorFlow 2.8 custom training

events.feature_name: Vertex AI pre-built PyTorch 1.10 custom training container

events.feature_name: Autopackaging for gcloud ai custom-jobs create

events.feature_name: Vertex AI interactive shells for custom training job inspection

Vertex Explainable AI is generally available, enabling model interpretability and explanation features within Vertex AI.
Vertex AI adds a pre-built container for serving predictions from TensorFlow 2.6 models.

events.feature_name: Cloud Storage Fuse support for Vertex AI custom training

events.feature_name: Pre-built custom training containers for TensorFlow 2.6 and PyTorch 1.9
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI custom training now supports using pre-built containers for TensorFlow 2.6 and PyTorch 1.9.

events.feature_name: Vertex Matching Engine Two Tower built-in algorithm

events.feature_name: Custom service accounts for Vertex AI custom training and prediction
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now supports using custom service accounts for custom training and prediction workloads.

events.feature_name: VPC Service Controls for Vertex AI
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now supports integration with VPC Service Controls to help isolate and secure access to the service.

events.feature_name: Private IP for Vertex AI custom training
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now enables private IP usage for custom training traffic via VPC Network Peering.

events.feature_name: Private endpoints for Vertex AI online prediction
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now provides private endpoints for online prediction in preview, enabling low-latency inference within a private network.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI custom training job interactive shell
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now lets users open an interactive shell inside a running custom training container for monitoring and debugging.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI training support for NVIDIA A100 GPUs and A2 machine types

Vertex AI added support for using a pre-built container to serve predictions from TensorFlow 2.5 models.
Vertex TensorBoard is available as a preview feature for tracking, visualizing, and comparing machine learning experiments.
Vertex AI added support for training custom models in selected regions.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI custom model batch prediction
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI added support for batch prediction with custom models in selected regions.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI custom model online prediction
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI added support for online prediction with custom models in selected regions.

Vertex AI added support for forecasting with time series data in AutoML tabular models, enabling future numeric predictions.
Vertex AI Feature Store is available in Preview as a centralized repository for organizing, storing, and serving ML features.
Vertex Pipelines is a service that automates, monitors, and governs ML workflows by orchestrating machine learning pipelines.
Vertex Matching Engine is a vector similarity search capability within Vertex AI.

Introduced a pre-built Vertex AI serving container to run predictions for XGBoost 1.3 models.
A pre-built container is available for serving predictions from TensorFlow 2.4 models.

events.feature_name: AI Platform custom training with PyTorch 1.7 pre-built container
events.feature_summary: A pre-built container was added to enable custom training jobs using PyTorch 1.7.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI pre-built TensorFlow 2.4 custom training container
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now supports a pre-built container for performing custom training jobs using TensorFlow 2.4.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI pre-built XGBoost 1.2 prediction serving container
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI now supports serving predictions from XGBoost 1.2 models using a pre-built container.

events.feature_name: AI Platform (Unified) regionalized data storage and processing

AI Platform (Unified) was made available as a Preview release.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Builder Agent Designer
events.feature_summary: Adds Agent Designer, a low-code visual environment in Google Cloud console for designing and testing agents.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine default CAA-managed agent identity credentials
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Engine now secures agent identity credentials by default through a Google-managed Context-Aware Access (CAA) policy.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine agent observability in Google Cloud console
events.feature_summary: Agent Engine now lets users configure, manage, and view agent observability features such as sessions, traces, logs, and events in the Google Cloud console.

events.feature_summary: The Google Cloud console now includes a playground to test and interact with agents in Vertex AI Agent Engine.

events.feature_summary: Developers can evaluate agents using the Gen AI evaluation service via the GenAI Client in the Vertex AI SDK.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank revision management
events.feature_summary: Memory Bank now supports creating and managing memory revisions.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Runtime IAM agent identity management
events.feature_summary: Users can use IAM to create agent identities for access and authentication management when using agents on Vertex AI Agent Engine Runtime.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Runtime Express mode
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Engine Runtime now supports an Express mode.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Runtime free tier
events.feature_summary: A free tier is now available for Vertex AI Agent Engine Runtime.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Code Execution
events.feature_summary: Agent Engine supports code execution so agents can run code in an isolated sandbox environment.

events.feature_name: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol support in Vertex AI Agent Engine
events.feature_summary: Agent Engine now supports developing, deploying, and using agents that follow the A2A protocol.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine bidirectional streaming
events.feature_summary: Agent Engine supports bidirectional streaming for agent interactions.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank console tab
events.feature_summary: The Agent Engine page in Cloud Console now includes a Memory Bank tab for displaying and managing memories.

events.feature_name: Private VPC and Private Service Connect deployment for Vertex AI Agent Engine
events.feature_summary: Agents can be deployed in a private VPC with a Private Service Connect interface to improve data privacy.

events.feature_name: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for Vertex AI Agent Engine
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Engine now supports encryption of data at rest using customer-managed encryption keys.

events.feature_name: Configurable resource controls in Vertex AI Agent Engine
events.feature_summary: Agent Engine allows customization of resource controls, including instance counts, container resource limits, and container concurrency.

events.feature_name: HIPAA workload support in Vertex AI Agent Engine
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Engine is supported for HIPAA workloads as part of the Vertex AI Platform.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank is now available in Preview and generates long-term memories dynamically from users' agent conversations.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Garden tag filtering
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Garden now supports filtering resources by tags.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine Console support for managing deployed agents
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Engine now adds console-based management capabilities for deployed agents.

events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Agent Engine now supports sessions for agents built with the Agent Development Kit.
