events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine LlamaIndex Query Pipeline integration
events.feature_summary: LlamaIndex Query Pipeline integration is now available in preview for Vertex AI Agent Engine.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Agent Engine agent monitoring
events.feature_summary: Agent monitoring is now generally available for Vertex AI Agent Engine.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search answer generation with Gemini 3.1 Pro
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports generating answers using the Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview) model.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search answer generation with Gemini 3 Flash
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports generating answers using the Gemini 3 Flash (Preview) model.

events.feature_name: Project-level pricing model switch to general pricing
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now allows a project to switch from configurable subscription pricing to general pay-as-you-go pricing when all apps and data stores use the general model.

events.feature_name: Gemini 3 Pro answer generation for Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports generating answers with the Gemini 3 Pro model.

events.feature_name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search introduces a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server available at discoveryengine.googleapis.com/mcp in Public Preview.

events.feature_name: Pricing model switching for Vertex AI Search apps and data stores
events.feature_summary: Allows projects with configurable pricing enabled to switch Vertex AI Search apps and data stores between pay-as-you-go and monthly subscription pricing models.

events.feature_name: Document-level relevance filtering in Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Adds Public Preview support for filtering search results by document-level keyword or semantic relevance threshold so only documents above the selected threshold are returned.

Configurable pricing introduces subscription-based billing options for custom search apps and data stores, including storage and query subscriptions with optional add-on features instead of default pay-as-you-go pricing.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search natural language query filters
events.feature_summary: Natural language query filtering converts user queries against structured data stores into a residual query plus machine-generated filters for custom search apps attached to a single structured data store.
Vertex AI Search added support for specifying an allowlist of fields that can be used for natural-language filter extraction.

events.feature_name: Unstructured data import file size limit
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search updated unstructured data import limits to allow files up to 200 MB regardless of parser type.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Gemini layout parser
events.feature_summary: Adds a Public Preview Gemini-powered layout parser for unstructured-document data stores to perform PDF layout analysis and content extraction with improved table recognition, reading order, and text accuracy.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search layout parser DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX support
events.feature_summary: Adds generally available support in Vertex AI Search for parsing DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX formats in the layout parser, while both layout and digital parsers continue to support PDF and HTML.
Vertex AI Search custom ranking enables ranking search results using mathematical expressions over model signals and document fields.
Advanced autocomplete enables autocomplete support for Vertex AI Search blended search applications.

events.feature_name: Exact-match phrase search in Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Adds exact-match phrase search by requiring queries enclosed in double quotes to return results only when words appear in the same order.
Adds answer generation support using the Gemini 2.5 Flash model version (gemini-2.5-flash) for context-based question-and-answer tasks.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search layout parser HTML content exclusion
events.feature_summary: The layout parser now allows skipping specified HTML content during parsing using configurable exclusions such as tags, IDs, and CSS classes to reduce irrelevant boilerplate and improve indexed data quality.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search autocomplete PII risk settings
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search provides adjustable autocomplete controls to lower the risk of returning suggestions that contain personally identifiable information when using search history or user event data.

events.feature_name: Media Search query mode configuration and auto-selection
events.feature_summary: Media Search now supports full-query and search-as-you-type result modes, with an auto mode that dynamically selects the best mode and is enabled by default.

events.feature_name: Claim-level grounding scores in Check Grounding API
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search added Generally Available claim-level grounding scores from the Check Grounding API, returning a support score for each claim in an answer candidate.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Cloud Storage bucket streaming ingestion
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search can now stream unstructured data from a Cloud Storage bucket into a search data store at the bucket level for near real-time serving.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search answer responses with corpus images
events.feature_summary: In Public Preview, Vertex AI Search answer and follow-up responses can include a retrieved image from the data store for applicable unstructured data store queries using the layout parser via API.

events.feature_name: Chart generation in Vertex AI Search answers
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search can automatically generate and return charts in answer responses and follow-up interactions when query intent or response complexity indicates visual output is useful.

events.feature_name: Ranking visibility and custom ranking in Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search private preview exposes ranking signals for inspection and allows users to tune ranking by modifying predefined expressions or defining custom ranking expressions.

events.feature_name: Document relevance scores for search results
events.feature_summary: Returns a relevance score for each search result in a query, enabling downstream ranking or filtering of results for structured and unstructured data stores.
Allows user information to be provided with the answer method so generated answers can be personalized.
Adds answer streaming so generated answers are delivered in sequential parts, improving perceived latency during response generation.
Introduces IdentityMappingStore support for mapping identities from third-party applications to an identity provider to enforce access control with synchronized external users.

events.feature_name: Healthcare answer generation with Gemini 1.5 Flash 001 answer_gen/v2
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search added support for the gemini-1.5-flash-001/answer_gen/v2 model to perform answer generation in healthcare search apps.

events.feature_name: Search widget analytics metrics on Analytics page
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search added the ability to view widget metrics on the Analytics page for select Google Cloud customers.

events.feature_name: Grounded answer generation inputs for language and location
events.feature_summary: The Agent Builder grounded generation API now accepts an explicit language code and latitude/longitude values to localize answers and support location-based queries.
Vertex AI Agent Builder grounding via the grounded generation API now supports more than 35 languages, available as GA with allowlist.
Allows tuning recommendation ranking for media content by applying string and boolean schema filters with boost values from -1 to 1 to lower or raise results in API recommendation responses.
Introduces the gemini-1.5-flash-002-high-fidelity model in Public Preview for grounded answer generation with RAG, tuned for context-based question answering in specialized industries.

events.feature_name: Sitemap-based indexing and refresh for Vertex AI Search web pages
events.feature_summary: Adds support for indexing and refreshing web pages in an advanced-indexing-enabled data store by submitting XML sitemaps or sitemap indexes through the API.

events.feature_name: Media recommendation ingested data quality checks
events.feature_summary: Adds GA console-based quality checks for data ingested for media recommendations, providing suggestions to improve data without blocking ingestion.
Vertex AI Search answer streaming returns generated responses in sequential parts so users can view early answer segments while the remainder is still being generated.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search well-grounded answer filtering
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search can return only well-grounded answers using configurable grounding-score filters to suppress poorly grounded responses, with options for stricter or more inclusive answer selection.
Advanced autocomplete enables autocomplete functionality for blended search apps with options such as access control, language boosting, and rich suggestions (document or recent-search suggestions).

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search grounding support scores
events.feature_summary: The answer API can return aggregated grounding scores for answers and per-claim grounding scores, including support for summaries and follow-up answers.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for US and EU data stores
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search supports CMEK for data stored in US and EU multi-region data stores, allowing customers to use their own keys for encryption at rest.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search CMEK with external key manager and HSM
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search supports using external key manager (EKM) and hardware security module (HSM)-backed keys with CMEK.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search answers with summaries and follow-ups for blended search apps
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search adds support for the answer method on blended search apps, returning answer summaries and follow-up suggestions.
Dynamic retrieval for grounded results in Vertex AI Agent Builder allows selectively disabling grounding with Google Search so supported models can answer from their own knowledge.
Grounded results now include a redirection URI to the publisher’s source when using Grounding with Google Search, and this link remains accessible for up to 30 days.
Vertex AI Search now supports importing data from Firestore as a generally available import source.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Cloud SQL import
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports importing data from Cloud SQL as a generally available import source.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search RAG ranking model
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search has an updated ranking and reranking model for RAG documents that improves top-ranked relevance and provides more nuanced scores.
This feature enables natural-language understanding for structured data queries by rewriting user input into a textual query plus an explicit filter expression.

events.feature_name: Schema auto-detect disablement for structured data imports
events.feature_summary: This feature allows users to disable dynamic schema auto-detection during structured data import so only predefined schema fields are imported.

events.feature_name: Datetime and geolocation field detection for structured data imports
events.feature_summary: Structured data imports can automatically detect datetime and geolocation fields and assign corresponding schema types, with an option to force detected datetime fields to string and geolocation fields to object.

events.feature_name: Cloud Storage dataset synchronization for Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports creating data stores that periodically synchronize with Cloud Storage datasets on a configurable schedule, delivered in Public Preview.

events.feature_name: Search tuning for unstructured data stores
events.feature_summary: Search tuning for unstructured data stores is now generally available and supports tuning with uploaded training files, including data residency support for US, EU, and global stores.
Generative answers in Vertex AI Search received performance improvements.
Re-ranking for generative answers was updated to lower response latency.
Detection of adversarial queries for generative answers was updated to improve accuracy.
The layout parser converts documents into structured representations, exposing elements such as paragraphs, tables, lists, headings, and page headers and footers.
Domain verification for advanced website indexing enables associating a Vertex AI Search data store with a domain, including domains you do not own or cannot verify in Google Search Console.
Enables the answer method to use multi-step (ReAct) retrieval reasoning, including a configurable maximum number of steps.
Provides a public preview capability to evaluate generic search applications using sample query sets, helping assess ranking quality and bias over time.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search CMEK key rotation for data stores
events.feature_summary: Introduces key rotation for customer-managed encryption keys used by Vertex AI Search data stores associated with search apps, available in Private Preview.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search custom JSON schema for media data stores
events.feature_summary: Allows media data stores in Vertex AI Search to use customer-defined JSON schemas by mapping required key properties such as category, media_available_time, media_duration, title, and uri, in Public Preview.

events.feature_name: Schema editing for structured data imports in Vertex AI Search data stores
events.feature_summary: Allows users to review and edit a schema before importing structured data from BigQuery or Cloud Storage into a Vertex AI Search data store.

events.feature_name: Direct media data store creation in Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Enables media data stores to be created directly from the Data Stores page instead of only through the app creation workflow.

events.feature_name: Healthcare Search natural language query with generative AI answers
events.feature_summary: Healthcare Search now supports natural language querying of healthcare data with generative AI answers in GA with allowlist access.
Search results can be filtered by document-level estimated relevance using low, medium, or high thresholds in Vertex AI Search public preview.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search BigQuery data store synchronization
events.feature_summary: Adds support for creating Vertex AI Search data stores that periodically synchronize data from BigQuery datasets on configurable intervals (daily, every 3 days, or every 5 days).

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search media recommendations data quality check
events.feature_summary: Adds a requirements check capability that validates the quality of ingested data for media recommendations and surfaces warnings when key model and objective thresholds are not met.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search autocomplete enablement timing
events.feature_summary: Allows enabling autocomplete early before enough usage data is collected, trading initial suggestion coverage and quality for faster rollout.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search relevant answer filtering
events.feature_summary: Adds an option for the answer method to return responses only when search results are sufficiently relevant, otherwise showing a fallback message.

events.feature_name: Structured data for advanced website indexing
events.feature_summary: Enables Vertex AI Search advanced website indexing stores to use structured data such as schema.org markup to enrich indexing results.
Adds support for system instructions in prompts for grounded answers, allowing response behavior changes such as persona and output formatting.

events.feature_name: Answers with summaries and follow-ups (Answer API)
events.feature_summary: The Answer API in Vertex AI Search now supports answers with summaries and follow-up responses, and is available as a generally available feature.
Multi-step retrieval remains a public preview capability in Vertex AI Search.
Vertex AI Search supports specifying a language code in search queries to improve search result quality.
Adds result-boosting capabilities for Vertex AI Search that improve ranking for media applications and generic search apps using unstructured and website data.

events.feature_name: Set language codes for data stores
events.feature_summary: Introduces support for configuring language codes on Vertex AI Search data stores to improve extractive segments and extractive answers in search results.

Generate grounded answers enables Vertex AI Search to produce retrieval-augmented responses grounded in Google Search, inline text, or data stored in a Vertex AI Search data store, with support for single-turn and multi-turn interactions.
The Document Ranking API reranks a provided list of documents based on relevance to a query and is designed as a stateless API that does not require documents to be indexed beforehand.
The Check grounding API determines how grounded a piece of text is in a set of facts and returns grounding support scores and citations.
Ordering healthcare search results enables ranking FHIR search results that contain unstructured text by relevance to the user query.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Answer Generation model gemini-1.0-pro-002/answer_gen/v1
events.feature_summary: Availability was added for the answer generation model gemini-1.0-pro-002/answer_gen/v1 in Vertex AI Search.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Boost search results
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search introduced Public Preview support for boosting search results in media apps and generic search apps that use unstructured and website data.

events.feature_name: Structured data for advanced website indexing
events.feature_summary: Enables advanced website indexing data stores to use structured data such as Google-inferred page dates, meta tags, and PageMap content to enrich indexed content.
Provides a public preview API that evaluates how well generated text is grounded in provided facts and returns support scores and citations, including conflicting citations in experimental mode.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search data import connectors for Spanner, Cloud SQL, Firestore, and Bigtable
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search added public preview support for importing data from Cloud Spanner, Cloud SQL, Firestore, and Bigtable.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search search-as-you-type for media applications
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search introduced search-as-you-type for media applications, returning results after each character via the widget UI and API.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search media search supported languages
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search for media now supports media search in Arabic, English, French, German, Hindi, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese, and Spanish.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search healthcare search autocomplete
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search adds autocomplete for healthcare search as a Public Preview feature using a canonical medical data source to generate suggestions.
Introduces a stateless Document Ranking API that reranks provided documents by relevance to a query without requiring prior indexing.

events.feature_name: Document Chunking for Search Summaries and Follow-ups
events.feature_summary: Adds document chunking support for unstructured data stores so search summaries and search with follow-up queries are available in Public Preview.

events.feature_name: Google Drive sync for Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search GA support allows synchronizing data from Google Drive into a Vertex AI Search data store.

events.feature_name: Blended search in Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search GA support enables blended search, allowing a single search app to query multiple data stores.

events.feature_name: Answer API with summaries and follow-ups
events.feature_summary: The Answer API adds Public Preview support for generating answers with summaries and follow-up search interactions to handle more complex, multi-step retrieval queries.
Healthcare FHIR search data stores gain Private Preview support for streaming import, allowing ongoing ingestion in addition to one-time batch import.

events.feature_name: Multiple search apps per data store
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports connecting multiple search apps to the same data store so multiple apps can query shared data without re-ingestion.
Vertex AI Search Autocomplete is now generally available in the US and EU multi-regions as well as global regions, and now supports Access Transparency logging.
Vertex AI Search provides GA support for media recommendations analytics with analytics visibility for media recommendations apps in the Google Cloud console.
Vertex AI Search made the use of structured data stores generally available.

events.feature_name: Structured data store field value types
events.feature_summary: Structured data stores in Vertex AI Search now support geolocation and datetime field value types.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search adjacent chunk retrieval
events.feature_summary: Enables search responses to include chunks that appear immediately before and after the most relevant chunk in a source document.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search chunk page-span metadata
events.feature_summary: Adds page-span information to chunk metadata in search responses to show where each chunk appears in the source document.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search list chunks API
events.feature_summary: Introduces the ability to list all chunks associated with a specific source document.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search get chunk API
events.feature_summary: Introduces the ability to retrieve an individual chunk from a source document.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search parsed document JSON retrieval
events.feature_summary: Adds support for getting parsed or chunked documents in JSON format.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search bring your own chunks
events.feature_summary: Adds a preview allowlist feature that lets users upload documents already chunked before indexing.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search extractive segments with relevance scores (GA)
events.feature_summary: Makes extractive segments and their relevance scores for extractive segments generally available.
Allows Vertex AI Search to boost relevance rankings using custom numerical attributes and freshness signals.
Enables Vertex AI Search to ingest and index content from Google Drive as a data source.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search parser selection for unstructured data
events.feature_summary: Adds support for specifying parsers for unstructured content uploads during data store creation, including default and file-type override parser settings.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search ServiceNow data source connector
events.feature_summary: Adds a Private Preview integration that allows Vertex AI Search to connect to ServiceNow as a third-party data source.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search document chunking for RAG
events.feature_summary: Enable document chunking when creating a Vertex AI Search data store so ingested documents are split into chunks and retrieval for RAG can return chunk-level results.

events.feature_name: Watch duration per session business objective for Vertex AI Search media recommendations
events.feature_summary: Allow media recommendations apps in Vertex AI Search to optimize for watch duration per session as a business objective.
Search analytics is now generally available for global Vertex AI Search data stores, with analytics for US and EU multi-region data stores still in Public Preview.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search data source access control
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search offers Public Preview access control for BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Confluence data sources so users see only results they are authorized to access.
Vertex AI Search introduces the ability to choose tuned or non-tuned search behavior for individual queries, enabling per-query comparison during testing.
Vertex AI Search adds Blended Search in Public Preview, allowing a single generic search app to query multiple connected data stores and data types.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search advanced website indexing metadata schema
events.feature_summary: Enables adding metadata fields to the data store schema so that indexed web content can be enriched when advanced website indexing is enabled.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search automatic web page refresh
events.feature_summary: Adds conditional automatic refresh of web pages for stores using advanced website indexing.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Terraform search app provisioning
events.feature_summary: Terraform support was added to create and provision Vertex AI Search apps.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Gemini Pro answer generation model gemini-pro@001/answer_gen/v1
events.feature_summary: The Gemini Pro answer generation model variant gemini-pro@001/answer_gen/v1 became generally available as a stable model for answer generation.

events.feature_name: Terraform support for Vertex AI Search data store creation
events.feature_summary: Terraform can be used to create empty Vertex AI Search and Conversation data stores, with data ingestion handled later through console or API workflows.
Autocomplete for Vertex AI Search became available as Public Preview in US and EU multi-regions and now removes unsafe or offensive terms in multiple languages, including English.
Vertex AI Search now supports using Gemini Pro as the model for generating search summaries.
Introduces the Preview, allowlist-only CheckGrounding API, which scores text grounding against provided facts and returns citations per statement.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports GA customer-managed encryption keys for data stores in US and EU regions, allowing customers to use their own keys to encrypt data at rest.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search data source access control
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search adds preview support for access-controlled data sources in BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Confluence, using identity provider-based authorization to limit which search results users can see.

events.feature_name: Bring your own parsed documents for Vertex AI Search data stores
events.feature_summary: Adds support in preview for importing pre-parsed unstructured documents into Vertex AI Search data stores, allowing users to submit parsed content instead of raw PDFs.

events.feature_name: Serving configurations for Vertex AI Search media recommendations
events.feature_summary: Allows creating, editing, and deleting multiple serving configurations for media recommendation apps and selecting different configs per request to tune demotion and diversity.

Media search (preview with allowlist) enables creating media search applications on media data stores, connecting them to existing or new media data stores, and filtering search queries using document metadata.
Customized summaries allows users to provide natural-language instructions to tailor summaries returned for search with answers and follow-ups via console or API.

events.feature_name: Access Transparency for Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now supports Access Transparency and the feature is generally available.

events.feature_name: Citations with metadata for Vertex AI Search summaries
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search now provides citation metadata for summaries, including referenced sources and sentence-level source attribution, in Public Preview.
Adds an API-based feature to estimate the size of web data before importing it into a Vertex AI Search data store.
Introduces Search tuning in Public Preview, allowing users to upload additional training data to tune search models and improve search results.

events.feature_name: OCR processing for PDFs in Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Introduces OCR processing in Vertex AI Search during data store creation to extract text blocks and tables from non-searchable PDFs or PDFs with table-heavy content.

events.feature_name: Company name field for search apps
events.feature_summary: Adds support for specifying a company or organization name when creating a Vertex AI Search app to improve summarization and follow-up response quality.
Vertex AI Search adds follow-up query filtering, allowing search results to be filtered during follow-up interactions for website and structured data.
Vertex AI Search introduces Blended Search in preview with allowlist, enabling a single generic search app to search across multiple data stores and data types.
Vertex AI Search allows existing data stores to be upgraded to use advanced website indexing.
Vertex AI Search’s search capability is now supported in 25 languages.
Vertex AI Search snippets are now supported in 25 languages.
Vertex AI Search extractive answers are now supported in 25 languages.
Vertex AI Search summarization is now supported in most languages.
Vertex AI Search introduced preview capability to import autocomplete denylists for supported accounts via allowlist access.
Vertex AI Search added support for extractive answers in additional languages, including Arabic, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search multi-region support (US and EU)
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search adds General Availability support for deployment and usage in the US and EU multi-region locations.

Vertex AI Search introduces a media recommendations capability for building apps that recommend media content such as videos, news, and music, including migration of existing Discovery for Media data and models.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search EU customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)
events.feature_summary: Adds support for using customer-managed encryption keys to encrypt data at rest for EU multi-region Vertex AI Search data stores in allowlist preview.
Adds Search tuning for Enterprise Search, allowing users to provide query and segment pair data to train and improve model relevance.

events.feature_name: Access Transparency for Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search (Enterprise Search) added preview support for Access Transparency.
Vertex AI Search (Enterprise Search) expanded language coverage for search, snippets, and related features to include Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Greek, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean, and Russian.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) integration
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search supports a customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) allowlisted preview, allowing customers to use their own key to encrypt US multi-region datastore contents at rest.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search search citation support for follow-up responses
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search adds citation output for search with follow-up queries by indicating which search results each summary sentence is derived from.
Vertex AI Search supports configuring data location settings for Enterprise Search to align with data residency requirements.

events.feature_name: Adversarial query filtering for search follow-up summaries
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search can ignore adversarial follow-up queries so summary generation is avoided for unsafe or policy-violating inputs.

events.feature_name: Non-summary-seeking query filtering for search follow-up summaries
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search can ignore follow-up queries that are not seeking a summary, preventing unhelpful summary generation.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search third-party data connectors for Enterprise Search data stores
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Search adds support for syncing Enterprise Search data stores with external sources like Jira, Confluence, and Salesforce through third-party data connectors in private preview.
Vertex AI Search allows manual refreshing of specific web pages in a data store using the recrawlUris method when Advanced website indexing is enabled.

events.feature_name: Summarization language support for Vertex AI Search
events.feature_summary: Expanded Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search summarization to support languages beyond English, including German, Spanish, Italian, French, Dutch, Portuguese, and Swedish.
Added a preview, allowlist-based option to return up to three adjacent text segments before and after the relevant extractive segment for better context, with potential latency increase.
Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search added customizable summaries in preview with allowlist, allowing natural-language instructions to tune summary length, detail, style, language, focus, and format.
Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search added page numbers on extractive segments to indicate where each extracted answer appears in the source document.
Enterprise Search introduced a preview feature that provides related questions as follow-up prompts during search.
Enterprise Search expanded its supported languages by adding support for more languages.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search multi-region data store locations
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search data stores can now be created in global, US multi-region, or EU multi-region locations.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search snippet status in results
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search now returns snippet status together with the snippet in search responses.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search extractive answer page-number metadata
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search extractive answers now include the source document page number where each answer was found.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search Enterprise Search extractive segment result limit
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search can now return up to 10 extractive segments per search result.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search extractive segment confidence scores
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search now provides confidence scores for extractive segments in allowlist preview, based on similarity between the query and the extracted segment.
Search with follow-ups (formerly called multi-turn search) is now Generally Available in Enterprise Search for websites with advanced indexing enabled and unstructured data.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search SafeSearch support for follow-up search
events.feature_summary: SafeSearch is supported when using Enterprise Search's search with follow-ups capability.

events.feature_name: conversations.converse v1 response summary object migration
events.feature_summary: The `conversations.converse` v1 API response for follow-up/answer workflows was changed to use a summary object instead of the previous reply and references objects.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search website domain verification for advanced website indexing
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search requires users to verify ownership of website domains when those sites are indexed in data stores with advanced website indexing enabled.
Enterprise Search now supports allowlisted GA serving controls (boost, filter, synonym, and redirect) through API calls to influence returned search results.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search multi-turn conversational search UI
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search adds a multi-turn, conversational search experience in the Google Cloud console, currently available in preview.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search language support for search results and snippets
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search now supports search results and snippet display in multiple additional languages including Danish, Dutch, Hindi, Portuguese, and Swedish.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search support in VPC Service Controls
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search is supported within Google Cloud VPC Service Controls as a preview capability.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search multilingual search and snippets support
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search added support for French (fr-FR) language outputs for search and snippet results.
Enterprise Search supports using customer-provided vector embeddings in preview by allowing users to upload custom embeddings and apply them during search.
Enterprise Search adds a preview capability to exclude summaries in responses when requests are identified as adversarial.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search ignore non-summary seeking queries
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search adds a preview capability to omit summaries in responses when requests are non-summary seeking.
Enterprise Search now provides citations for generated summaries, linking each summary sentence to its source search result.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search language support for search and snippets
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search now supports search and snippet results in en-US, es-ES, de-DE, and it-IT.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search snippets with hit highlighting
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search added snippets with hit highlighting in search responses for rendering highlighted result snippets in user interfaces.
Enterprise Search introduced extractive segments in preview, returning verbatim text per result for display, post-processing, or large-language-model input.
Image search allows searching a website with a Base64-encoded image query via API to return similar images.
Extractive answers is a preview feature that returns verbatim text snippets from search result documents, displayed as concise answers near the top of web pages.

Enterprise Search OCR processing is available to improve PDF parsing and segmentation during data ingestion, enabling better handling of structures like paragraphs and tables for more accurate search results and summaries.
Enterprise Search schema editing enables viewing and updating schemas for structured data stores directly in the Google Cloud console and is available in preview.
Personalize is a Gen App Builder recommendation feature that builds AI-powered recommendation engines from your own data to suggest documents similar to the one a user is currently viewing.
Enterprise Search introduces a Purge Data action on the Documents page that enables deletion of data from a data store.
Enterprise Search now supports configurations and controls required for HIPAA compliance.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search analytics dashboard time-period comparison
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search analytics now allows comparing metrics for two time periods in the preview analytics dashboard.
Enterprise Search supports multi-turn search in allowlisted preview, allowing follow-up questions to be answered in context.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search support for PPTX, DOCX, and TXT formats
events.feature_summary: Enterprise Search adds preview support for searching unstructured content in PPTX, DOCX, and TXT files (in addition to HTML and PDF).
Enables collecting user feedback on Enterprise Search widget results using thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings, with optional dislike reasons.

events.feature_name: Enterprise Search advanced autocomplete document data model
events.feature_summary: Introduces an experimental advanced autocomplete document data model that uses large language models to generate high-quality autocomplete suggestions.
Enterprise Search now supports a documents.purge method to delete data from a datastore.
Enterprise Search now supports image search on websites by submitting a text query and returning image results.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Search: Enterprise Search engine creation from Google Cloud Console
events.feature_summary: Introduced the ability to create Enterprise Search search engines for unstructured data directly from the Google Cloud console.
Motion filtering now supports defining specific zones or exclusion areas to control where motion is detected.
The vaictl command-line tool now includes a visualization command to display Vertex AI Vision model outputs over real-time video streams with annotations and statistics.
Visualization in vaictl now supports rendering Occupancy Analytics model annotations.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Vision Warehouse batch support for videos and images
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Vision Warehouse introduced general availability of batch support for video and image data.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Vision Warehouse semantic and similarity search on videos and images
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Vision Warehouse now supports semantic and similarity search capabilities over video and image content.
A Python SDK was introduced for Vertex AI Vision, enabling Python-based development for Vision features.
Vertex AI Vision introduced a preview batch image processing feature that accepts a Cloud Storage input path of images and writes processed batch results to a Cloud Storage output path.
Vertex AI Vision added model event management to send event notifications through Pub/Sub, including support for sending events to configured topics from supported models via Cloud Functions.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench startup script dependency removal
events.feature_summary: The Vertex AI Workbench M139 release removed the startup script dependency on the gs://dl-platform-public-configs location for instances.

events.feature_name: Gemini CLI support in Vertex AI Workbench
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench added a preview of the Gemini CLI in instances, allowing terminal-based notebook and cloud-task workflows directly from Workbench.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench post-startup daemon persistence
events.feature_summary: Daemon processes launched by post-startup scripts in Vertex AI Workbench instances now continue running after the script finishes.

events.feature_name: JupyterLab 4+ for Vertex AI Workbench instances
events.feature_summary: New Vertex AI Workbench instances can now be created with JupyterLab 4+.

events.feature_name: Managed user credential access for instance creation
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench now supports creating instances with managed user credential access.

events.feature_name: Post-startup scripts for private GA instances with user credentials
events.feature_summary: Using post-startup scripts for new Vertex AI Workbench instances with user credential access is now available in private GA.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench custom Jupyter username sudo behavior
events.feature_summary: The M137 release fixed a bug where Workbench instances prompted for a password when using a custom Jupyter username and invoking sudo.

events.feature_name: Confidential Computing for Vertex AI Workbench instances
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench now supports data-in-use encryption through Confidential Computing by enabling Confidential VM services when creating an instance.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench instance image output rendering
events.feature_summary: Fixes the image output rendering bug so notebook instance image outputs display correctly in Vertex AI Workbench.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench Notebooks API OS shutdown reporting
events.feature_summary: Restores reporting of user-triggered OS shutdown events to the Notebooks API for Vertex AI Workbench instances.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench custom notebook metrics reporting
events.feature_summary: Patches a regression in custom notebook metrics reporting for Vertex AI Workbench instances, including metrics such as jupyterlab_kernels and docker_status.
Updates the Dataproc JupyterLab plugin used with Vertex AI Workbench to version 0.1.92.

events.feature_name: Google Cloud CLI preset properties for Vertex AI Workbench
events.feature_summary: Prepopulates project and region properties when using Google Cloud CLI commands with Vertex AI Workbench instances.

events.feature_name: Workforce Identity Federation for Vertex AI Workbench instances
events.feature_summary: Makes Workforce Identity Federation generally available for creating and managing Vertex AI Workbench instances using external identity provider credentials.
The Dataproc JupyterLab plugin was updated in Vertex AI Workbench to resolve an incompatibility when using instances with end-user credentials enabled.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench managed end-user credentials
events.feature_summary: Workbench instances using managed end-user credentials support had an incompatibility fix to improve compatibility with the Dataproc JupyterLab workflow.
The scheduler Jupyter plugin is now preinstalled in JupyterLab 4 and includes support for Cloud Composer and Vertex AI notebook schedulers.
The Dataproc JupyterLab plugin was updated to version 0.1.90 in Vertex AI Workbench instances.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench managed end-user credentials (Preview)
events.feature_summary: The managed end-user credentials preview feature was patched to fix an incompatibility when listing Dataproc remote kernels.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench instance provisioning with proxy access disabled
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench instances were patched so that provisioning no longer stalls when proxy access is disabled.

events.feature_name: Compute Engine reservations for Vertex AI Workbench instances
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench instances can now consume Compute Engine zonal reservations to increase the likelihood that required resources are available for job execution.
The Dataproc JupyterLab plugin in Vertex AI Workbench was updated to version 0.1.89 in the M131 release.
The Dataproc JupyterLab plugin in Vertex AI Workbench instances was updated to version 0.1.87.
The BigQuery JupyterLab plugin was added to Vertex AI Workbench instances.
Vertex AI Workbench now sets the GOOGLE_CLOUD_REGION environment variable by default.

events.feature_name: Reservations with Vertex AI Workbench instances
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench instances now support consuming Compute Engine zonal reservations in Preview.
Vertex AI Workbench instances now include an updated Dataproc JupyterLab plugin version 0.1.85.

events.feature_name: Back up and restore data on Vertex AI Workbench instances
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench instances now support backing up and restoring instance data as a generally available capability.

events.feature_name: Confidential Computing for Vertex AI Workbench instances
events.feature_summary: Adds support for data-in-use encryption by enabling the Confidential VM service when creating a Vertex AI Workbench instance.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench managed notebooks M128 package updates
events.feature_summary: Includes miscellaneous package updates in the M128 release of Vertex AI Workbench managed notebooks.
The M128 release provides miscellaneous package updates for Vertex AI Workbench instances.
The M128 release provides miscellaneous package updates for Vertex AI Workbench user-managed notebooks.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench managed notebooks authorized SSH key home directory ownership
events.feature_summary: Fixes an issue where home directory ownership could be incorrect when using authorized SSH keys with Vertex AI Workbench managed notebooks.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench instances authorized SSH key home directory ownership
events.feature_summary: Fixes an issue where home directory ownership could be incorrect when using authorized SSH keys with Vertex AI Workbench instances.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench user-managed notebooks SSH key home directory ownership
events.feature_summary: The user-managed notebooks feature corrected home directory ownership behavior when using authorized SSH keys.

events.feature_name: JupyterLab version in Vertex AI Workbench managed notebooks
events.feature_summary: Managed notebooks were updated to include JupyterLab version 3.6.8.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench user-managed notebooks JupyterLab 3.6.8 upgrade
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench user-managed notebooks now include an upgrade to JupyterLab version 3.6.8.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench JupyterLab 4+ preview for new instances
events.feature_summary: JupyterLab 4+ is available in preview on new Vertex AI Workbench instances at creation time.

events.feature_name: Vertex AI Workbench instances JupyterLab 3.6.8 upgrade
events.feature_summary: Vertex AI Workbench instances have been upgraded to include JupyterLab version 3.6.8.
A security patch in the M125 release fixed adm and docker permission handling for user-managed notebooks when root access is not enabled.
A security patch in the M125 release fixed adm and docker permission handling for managed notebooks when root access is not enabled.
Bigframes 1.9.0 is available on Vertex AI Workbench instances across all environments except TensorFlow.
Vertex AI Workbench instances now avoid the M124-introduced regression that downgraded Conda to an older version.
A vulnerability affecting ADM and Docker permissions on Vertex AI Workbench instances without root access has been patched.
Vertex AI Workbench instances now support backing up and restoring instance data, available in Preview.

events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect support for accessing managed services with consumer-side HTTP(S) controls is now generally available for the global external HTTP(S) load balancer.

events.feature_name: Connected consumer forwarding rules metric for Private Service Connect producers
events.feature_summary: Cloud Monitoring now supports the Private Service Connect producer metric for connected consumer forwarding rules.

events.feature_name: Used NAT IP addresses metric for Private Service Connect producers
events.feature_summary: Cloud Monitoring now supports the Private Service Connect producer metric for used NAT IP addresses.
VPC subnets now support dual-stack networking with both IPv4 and IPv6 address ranges in all regions.
VPC now supports subnet routes for IPv6 subnet ranges in all regions.
VPC instances now support dual-stack networking with both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, including multiple network interfaces, in all regions.
VPC network firewall policies provide centralized firewall policy management for traffic control across resources.
Regional firewall policies allow firewall rule enforcement scoped to a single VPC region.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect publishing for Internal TCP/UDP Load Balancer with global access
events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect supports publishing services behind an Internal TCP/UDP load balancer with global access enabled.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect publishing for internal protocol forwarding (target instances)
events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect supports publishing services that are hosted behind internal protocol forwarding using target instances.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect internal regional TCP proxy load balancer service publishing
events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect now supports publishing services from a service producer VPC network via an internal regional TCP proxy load balancer, including backends hosted in Google Cloud, other clouds, and on-premises environments.

events.feature_name: VPC subnet jumbo frame MTU support
events.feature_summary: VPC networks now support jumbo frames by allowing MTUs between 1300 and 8896 bytes for resources within the same subnet.
Expanded Auto mode VPC network IP ranges by adding a new 10.206.0.0/20 subnet in the us-south1 (Dallas) region.
Expanded Auto mode VPC network IP ranges by adding a new 10.202.0.0/20 subnet in the us-east5 (Columbus) region.

events.feature_name: Compute Engine IPv6 access to Google APIs
events.feature_summary: Compute Engine instances can access Google APIs and services using IPv6 either through internal Private Google Access or through external IPv6 addresses.

events.feature_name: Auto mode VPC regional subnet allocation
events.feature_summary: Auto mode VPC networks now include a predefined subnet of 10.204.0.0/20 in the Madrid (europe-southwest1) region.

events.feature_name: Static regional external IPv6 address reservation
events.feature_summary: VPC introduced limited-preview support for reserving static regional external IPv6 addresses.

events.feature_name: Auto mode VPC subnet range for europe-west9
events.feature_summary: Auto mode VPC networks added a new subnet range, 10.200.0.0/20, for the Paris (europe-west9) region.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect automatic DNS configuration
events.feature_summary: Adds automatic DNS configuration for Private Service Connect endpoints by creating a DNS entry when a managed service specifies a domain name and a consumer creates an endpoint to that service.

events.feature_name: Auto mode VPC subnet for Milan (europe-west8)
events.feature_summary: Introduces a new 10.198.0.0/20 subnet for auto mode VPC networks in the Milan (europe-west8) region.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect consumer HTTP(S) controls for managed service access
events.feature_summary: Adds support for accessing managed services through Private Service Connect using consumer HTTP(S) controls.

events.feature_name: Predefined firewall rules for custom mode VPC networks
events.feature_summary: When creating a custom mode VPC network, users can now select predefined firewall rules to quickly apply common instance connectivity patterns.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect access from on-premises via Cloud VPN
events.feature_summary: VPC-connected on-premises hosts using Cloud VPN can now access published services through a Private Service Connect endpoint in General Availability.

events.feature_name: Auto mode VPC subnet range expansion
events.feature_summary: Auto mode VPC networks now include a new /20 subnet, 10.194.0.0/20, in the Santiago (southamerica-west1) region.

events.feature_name: Legacy VPC to custom mode network conversion
events.feature_summary: Converting single-region legacy networks to custom mode VPC networks is now available in Preview.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect automatic Service Directory registration
events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect now automatically registers managed-service endpoints in Service Directory so consumers can discover them without manual registration.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect internal HTTP(S) load balancer backend publishing
events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect now supports publishing services backed by internal HTTP(S) load balancer backends, and this capability is generally available.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect on-premises access via Cloud VPN
events.feature_summary: Added preview support for accessing published services through a Private Service Connect endpoint from on-premises hosts connected to a VPC network via Cloud VPN.
Introduced General Availability for Packet Mirroring with full control over which protocols are included in mirrored traffic.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect consumer HTTP(S) service controls
events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect now supports using consumer HTTP(S) service controls to access supported regional service endpoints in Preview.

events.feature_name: Auto mode VPC network IP ranges
events.feature_summary: Auto mode VPC networking added a predefined 10.188.0.0/20 subnet for the Toronto (northamerica-northeast2) region.
Private Service Connect enables publishing services and accessing published services over private networking.

events.feature_name: External IPv6 addresses for VM instances
events.feature_summary: Virtual machine instances can be assigned external IPv6 addresses in supported regions.
VPC now provides a system-generated default IPv6 route with a next-hop set to the default-internet-gateway.
Firewall rules now support references to IPv6 address ranges.

events.feature_name: Hierarchical firewall rules with IPv6 address ranges
events.feature_summary: Hierarchical firewall rules can now use IPv6 address ranges for matching and enforcement.
Deleting a Private Service Access connection now also removes configurations created by the service producer, simplifying recreation after deletion.

events.feature_name: Auto mode subnet range expansion in asia-south2
events.feature_summary: Added an auto mode VPC subnet range of 10.190.0.0/20 for the Delhi (asia-south2) region to update Auto mode IP ranges.
Added a new auto mode VPC network subnet range (10.192.0.0/20) in the Melbourne (australia-southeast2) region.
Introduced Bring Your Own IP (BYOIP) for Google Cloud VPC in General Availability.
Private Service Connect adds support for publishing services and accessing those published services over private connections.
VPC network GRE support adds General Availability for Generic Routing Encapsulation tunneling in Google Cloud Virtual Private Cloud.
Private Service Connect became generally available for access to Google APIs and services.
Auto mode VPC networks added a new subnet 10.186.0.0/20 for the Warsaw (europe-central2) region.

events.feature_name: Shared VPC non-primary VM interface attachment for instance templates and managed instance groups
events.feature_summary: Allows VM instances created from instance templates or managed instance groups to attach network interfaces other than nic0 when connected to Shared VPC.

events.feature_name: Serverless VPC Access support for Shared VPC
events.feature_summary: Adds support for Serverless VPC Access workloads to connect to Shared VPC networks.
Hierarchical firewall policies are now generally available for centralized firewall policy management in Virtual Private Cloud.

events.feature_name: Additional VM network interfaces in Shared VPC
events.feature_summary: VPC now supports connecting VM network interfaces other than nic0 in Shared VPC, with this capability generally available for individual VM instances while template- and instance-group-based workflows remain in preview.
Cloud Interconnect now supports 1500-byte MTU, enabling larger packet payloads in General Availability.

events.feature_name: Private Service Connect API and service access
events.feature_summary: Private Service Connect now supports accessing Google APIs and services in Preview.
Introduces DNS peering support for Private Service Access, allowing private services to resolve DNS through VPC peering.

events.feature_name: Shared VPC support for non-primary VM interfaces
events.feature_summary: Adds preview support for connecting VM interfaces other than nic0 to Shared VPC, currently for individual VM instances only.
Packet Mirroring supports configuration of traffic direction for mirrored packets in Google Cloud Virtual Private Cloud.

events.feature_name: DNS Peering for Private Services Access
events.feature_summary: DNS peering is available for Private Services Access in Google Cloud Virtual Private Cloud in Preview.
VPC networks now support a maximum transmission unit (MTU) of 1500 bytes.

events.feature_name: VPC firewall rule logging metadata controls
events.feature_summary: Firewall Rule Logging in VPC now includes controls for logging metadata.
Virtual Private Cloud added support for GRE routing in VPC networks, available in Beta.

events.feature_name: Serverless VPC Access for Shared VPC
events.feature_summary: Serverless VPC Access support for Shared VPC was introduced in VPC, available in Beta.
Firewall Rules Logging metadata controls in VPC introduce configurable control over metadata included in firewall logs.

events.feature_name: Auto mode VPC subnet for Jakarta
events.feature_summary: Auto mode VPC networks now include a new 10.184.0.0/20 subnet for the asia-southeast2 (Jakarta) region.
Introduces hierarchical firewall policies in VPC, enabling firewall policy configuration in a hierarchical structure.

events.feature_name: GKE annotations for VPC Flow Logs
events.feature_summary: Adds support for GKE annotations to control VPC Flow Logs behavior.

events.feature_name: Advanced controls for VPC Flow Logs
events.feature_summary: Makes advanced VPC Flow Logs controls available for users to configure logging behavior in more detail.

events.feature_name: VPC subnet support for non-RFC 1918 IP ranges
events.feature_summary: VPC subnets now support IP address ranges that are not restricted to RFC 1918 private ranges.

events.feature_name: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts
events.feature_summary: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts now allows traffic from any internal IP address, including non-RFC 1918 addresses.
Google Cloud VPC auto mode networks now include a new subnet range (10.182.0.0/20) in the us-west4 (Las Vegas) region.
Packet Mirroring reached General Availability in Virtual Private Cloud.

events.feature_name: Auto mode VPC network IP range for us-west3
events.feature_summary: Auto mode VPC networks added an automatic subnet allocation of 10.180.0.0/20 for the us-west3 (Salt Lake City) region.

events.feature_name: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts
events.feature_summary: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts was updated to allow traffic from any internal IP address range, rather than only RFC 1918 addresses.
Serverless VPC Access is now generally available as a feature that enables serverless workloads to connect to Virtual Private Cloud networks.

events.feature_name: 2/4 vCPU virtual machine egress bandwidth limit of 10 Gbps
events.feature_summary: Virtual machines with 2 or 4 vCPUs gained a maximum egress throughput of 10 Gbps.

events.feature_name: Private Google Access private.googleapis.com virtual IP range for on-premises hosts
events.feature_summary: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts has made the private.googleapis.com virtual IP address range generally available.

events.feature_name: VPC Network Peering custom route import and export
events.feature_summary: VPC Network Peering now supports importing and exporting custom routes, and this capability is generally available.
Packet Mirroring allows administrators to capture and replicate network traffic for inspection, analysis, and security monitoring.

events.feature_name: VPC Flow Logs log volume reduction
events.feature_summary: VPC Flow Logs now provides an option to reduce the volume of logs generated from network flow traffic.

events.feature_name: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts: private.googleapis.com virtual IP range
events.feature_summary: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts adds a dedicated private.googleapis.com virtual IP address range in Beta.
Increased virtual machine egress network I/O is now available at 32 Gbps for VMs using the Skylake CPU platform or ultramem machine types.
Serverless VPC Access enables serverless services to connect to Virtual Private Cloud networks.

events.feature_name: 32 Gbps VM network egress for Skylake and ultramem instances
events.feature_summary: Virtual machine network I/O egress for Skylake CPU platform and ultramem machine types is increased to up to 32 Gbps in beta.

events.feature_name: VPC Flow Logs log volume reduction
events.feature_summary: VPC Flow Logs introduces a beta option to reduce the volume of logs that are generated.

events.feature_name: VPC Network Peering custom route import/export
events.feature_summary: VPC Network Peering adds beta support for importing and exporting custom routes.
Private Services Access in Virtual Private Cloud reached general availability.

events.feature_name: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts
events.feature_summary: The private access option for on-premises hosts with only private IP addresses became generally available via Cloud VPN or Cloud Interconnect.
The IPv4Range field used when creating legacy Google Cloud VPC networks is deprecated.
Firewall rule logging is now generally available in Virtual Private Cloud.

events.feature_name: Private Services Access IP address allocation
events.feature_summary: Private Services Access now supports allocating IP address ranges so services can be privately connected within a VPC.

events.feature_name: Private Google Access for on-premises hosts
events.feature_summary: Private Google Access now allows on-premises hosts using only private IPs to reach Google APIs over Cloud VPN or Cloud Interconnect.
Private Service Access provides a private connection from a VPC network to a network owned by Google or a third party.
Firewall rules logging enables logging of packets that match VPC firewall rules.
Virtual Private Cloud supports disabling firewall rules, enabling administrators to temporarily deactivate rules without deleting them.

events.feature_name: Shared VPC host project usable subnet listing
events.feature_summary: Shared VPC service projects can now list usable subnets from the host project in General Availability.
VPC Flow Logs were launched as a generally available feature.
Folder support for Shared VPC became available in beta.
Virtual Private Cloud added support for disabling firewall rules, allowing rules to be turned off without deletion.
Virtual Private Cloud introduced the ability to add and delete alias IP ranges, now available as a generally available feature.
VPC Flow Logs became available, allowing traffic logs for virtual private cloud networks to be captured and reviewed.

events.feature_name: Firewall rule egress and deny support
events.feature_summary: Firewall rules were expanded to support egress traffic controls, deny actions, and explicit rule evaluation ordering.
Alias IP Ranges enables assigning additional IP addresses to a VM instance for use by containers running on that VM.
Multiple Network Interfaces allows a VM instance to attach more than one virtual network interface, each connected to a different VPC network.
Google Cloud Virtual Private Cloud added support for reserving and using static internal IP addresses.
VPC Network Peering enables direct communication between VPC networks, including across organizations, using internal IP addresses.
Multiple Network Interfaces enables a VM instance to use more than one virtual network interface, with each interface attached to a different VPC network.
Shared VPC provides cross-project network sharing, succeeding the earlier Cross-Project Networking (XPN) model, and is now generally available.
Alias IP Ranges allows additional IP addresses to be assigned to a VM instance for use by containers on that VM.
VPC Network Peering enables connecting VPC networks, including across organizations, so their resources communicate via internal IP addresses.
Private Google Access allows Compute Engine VM instances to access Google APIs using internal IP addresses only.

events.feature_name: VPC Firewall egress and deny rules
events.feature_summary: VPC firewall now supports egress firewall rules, explicit deny rules, and configurable rule-priority evaluation ordering.
Shared VPC enables one host project to share a VPC network with other Google Cloud projects.
Private Google Access allows Compute Engine VM instances to access Google APIs using internal IP addresses only.
Virtual Private Cloud forwarding rules now support the ICMP protocol.
The Compute Network Admin IAM role is now generally available for VPC.
The Compute Security Admin IAM role is now generally available for VPC.
The IAM Service Account Actor role is now generally available for VPC.
Introduced protocol forwarding, which allows forwarding traffic to a single VM instance via forwarding rules and added support for AH, ESP, and SCTP protocols.
Added support for Target Instance resources to forward non-NAT'ed traffic to a single virtual machine instance.
VM Runtime now supports configuring the live migration `maxDowntime` parameter in the kubevirt migration policy to limit how long a VM can be paused at the end of migration.
VM Runtime now supports the `virtctl diagnose` command for diagnosing VM issues.
VM Runtime now supports the `virtctl snapshot` command to collect VMRuntime logs for debugging.
Adds support for applying label updates to GVM resources at runtime by patching labels on VM Pods.
Adds support for configuring a GVM's running state (Running or Stopped) through the runningState field in the GVM resource spec.
Added support for local image caching within the same namespace.

events.feature_name: Anthos Clusters on Bare Metal 1.28.0 availability
events.feature_summary: Anthos Clusters on bare metal version 1.28.0 is now available for download.

events.feature_name: Rocky Linux GPU guest OS support
events.feature_summary: Added GPU support for Rocky Linux guest operating systems, with package management via dnf.

events.feature_name: Anthos clusters on bare metal 1.16.0 availability
events.feature_summary: Made Anthos clusters on bare metal version 1.16.0 available for download.

events.feature_name: Live VM CD-ROM hot-plug and ejection
events.feature_summary: Added support for inserting and ejecting CD-ROM devices on running virtual machines without interruption, including use of pre-open slots for later insertion.

events.feature_name: Persistent UEFI and TPM state for VMs
events.feature_summary: Added support for persisting UEFI and trusted platform module (TPM) state across VM restarts when enabled via VMRuntime feature gate VMPersistentState.
VM Runtime supports resizing VM disks, and when supported by the storage provider it automatically expands the underlying PVC and VM disk accordingly.
VM Runtime now enables optimized Hyper-V settings automatically for Windows guest OS on physical server environments to improve performance.
VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now upgrades base images to include security fixes for vulnerabilities.

events.feature_name: Virtio non-transitional driver configuration for SLES11
events.feature_summary: VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now supports configuring the virtio non-transitional driver for SLES11 by exposing the KubeVirt knob at the KubeVM layer.

events.feature_name: Robin storage class fencing for VM Runtime HA
events.feature_summary: VM Runtime now triggers Robin storage fencing during HA failover to block access from failed nodes, enabling HA operation with Robin-backed block storage.

events.feature_name: Maintenance-mode triggered VM eviction and migration during cluster upgrades
events.feature_summary: VM Runtime now triggers VM eviction and live migration during cluster upgrades only after a node enters maintenance mode, using Anthos-on-Bare-Metal's entering maintenance window timeout and best-effort migration to already-upgraded nodes.

events.feature_name: Softening KubeVirt migration taints during cluster upgrades
events.feature_summary: VM Runtime now uses soft migration taints for KubeVirt during upgrades to address issues in single-control-node upgrade scenarios.
Adds support for Rocky Linux 8 as a guest operating system.
Adds support for SLES11 as a guest operating system.
Adds support for Ubuntu 22.04 as a guest operating system.

events.feature_name: MIG controller resilience to Kubernetes API server failures
events.feature_summary: Makes the MIG controller retry connections when the Kubernetes API server experiences temporary failures.
VM Runtime on Google Distributed Cloud now improves VNC access by adding a tablet mode for a better VNC experience.
